title: Senior Data Analyst
description: Own reporting and analysis for a business unit. Build dashboards, query large datasets and present insights to senior stakeholders.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Design, train and deploy machine learning models that power in-app features. Work with data scientists and cloud teams to take models from prototype to production.

title: Associate Product Manager
description: Partner with design and engineering to define what we build next. Run user interviews, prioritise the roadmap and keep delivery on track in agile teams.

title: Engineering Manager
description: Lead a team of software engineers: hire, coach, plan delivery and keep the architecture healthy. Balance technical decisions with business goals and report progress to leadership.

title: Technical Support Operations Lead
description:
Run the day-to-day operations of the technical support desk: triage escalations, improve runbooks and coordinate fixes with engineering. Write clear knowledge-base articles and report on service health.
